name: fx30-pixel-shift-4-images-nonpersistent
description: Session-only BK4 write of the FX30 Pixel Shift Multi Shoot mode. No 0x603/3 save is sent; a cold boot restores the previous value.

properties.note: BKID_APP_setting_px_shift_multi_shoot: 0=off, 1=4 images, 2=16 images. 1-byte live property; attr 0x60 in the LAX profiles.
